# s3 — Spec-Writer Architecture
**Session:** 3 of 14 | **Phase:** 1 (slate design) | **Output:** spec-writer architecture spec, no SKILL.md

The Spec-Writer is the utility skill that ingests the orchestrator's structured artifacts (Convening Block, CCR, TENSION block) and voice contributions, then formalizes them into the council's persistent spec corpus. It does not reason; it formalizes. It does not resolve tensions; it preserves and indexes them. It does not select voices; it formats what the orchestrator already routed. This document specifies its architecture. Phase 2 will translate these specifications into a SKILL.md.
The spec-writer is the bookkeeper of the slate. The orchestrator decides who speaks; the voices speak; the spec-writer writes it down so it survives.
